h1: Custom Sportswear for Teams, Events & Branding
metaDescription: Custom sportswear for teams, events, and branding. Order bulk polos, caps, socks, and more with your logo. Fast turnaround. Shop now.
introHtml:
Custom sportswear combines performance fabrics with your brand's identity. From moisture-wicking polos like the Rugby Polo to durable caps like the Pro-Lite Cap, these items are built for active use. Materials such as polyester blends, cotton, and fleece offer breathability, stretch, and long-lasting color retention. Decoration options include screen printing, embroidery, and heat transfer, ensuring your logo stays vibrant through repeated wear and washing. Whether you're outfitting a safety team with Safety Tees or a corporate run with BeWell™ Socks, bulk orders deliver consistent quality across every piece.

Marketing directors use branded sportswear for giveaways at trade shows and charity runs. HR directors appreciate the versatility for employee wellness programs and team-building events. Safety managers choose high-visibility options like the Safety Tee for field crews. Small business owners rely on custom caps and visors for affordable, everyday visibility. With minimum order quantities that fit small teams or large events, Perfect Imprints helps you create a cohesive look that works as hard as your people do.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom sportswear, focus on fabric quality and construction. Look for double-stitched seams, reinforced collars, and moisture-wicking or breathable materials. Items like the Rugby Polo use pique knit for durability, while the Pro-Lite Cap offers structured front panels for a crisp logo display. Avoid cheap blends that pill or fade after a few washes — your brand deserves consistent appearance across all sizes.

Materials and Build Quality

Polyester and cotton blends dominate sportswear for their balance of comfort and durability. Fleece gloves and BeWell™ Socks use thermal or moisture-wicking knits for performance. For outdoor events, consider UPF-rated fabrics or water-resistant finishes. Always request a swatch before placing a bulk order to verify color accuracy and feel.

Common Use Cases

Custom sportswear fits a range of scenarios. Marketing directors order logo-printed caps and visors for golf tournaments or trade shows. HR directors use branded polos and safety tees for employee uniforms or onboarding kits. Safety managers choose high-visibility styles for construction crews. Fundraisers and charity runs benefit from custom bandanas and performance socks as participant gifts.

Decoration Options

Embroidery works best on caps, polos, and fleece items — it adds a professional, durable finish. Screen printing is cost-effective for large quantities on cotton or polyester tees. Full-color heat transfer suits complex logos on performance fabrics. For items like the BeWell™ Socks, knit-in logos or small embroidery are ideal. Always test decoration on a sample to ensure adhesion and wash resistance.

Quantity Guidance and MOQ

Bulk sportswear orders typically start at 12 to 24 pieces per style and size. Wholesale pricing improves significantly as quantities increase — a run of 100+ units often cuts per-piece cost by 30% or more. If your team has a wide size range, order a balanced mix to avoid shortages. For large events, consider ordering extras for last-minute additions.

Common Buying Mistakes

One frequent error is ignoring size charts — sportswear fits vary by brand and style. Always request a sizing kit for your team. Another mistake is choosing a decoration method that doesn't suit the fabric. For example, screen printing on fleece can crack, while embroidery on thin performance tees may pucker. Finally, account for lead time: custom sportswear typically takes 2-4 weeks for production and shipping, so plan ahead for your event date.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom sportswear?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product. For most items like caps and tees, MOQ starts at 12 pieces. For decorated items like embroidered polos, MOQ may be 24 pieces. Contact us for product-specific MOQs.

faqs.q: Which decoration method is best for sportswear?
faqs.a: Embroidery is durable and professional for caps, polos, and fleece. Screen printing works well for cotton tees in large runs. Heat transfer is ideal for full-color logos on performance fabrics. We'll recommend the best option for your design.

faqs.q: How long does production and shipping take?
faqs.a: Typical production takes 2-3 weeks for screen printing or embroidery. Heat transfer orders may be faster. Shipping within the US adds 3-5 business days. Rush services are available for an additional fee.

faqs.q: Can I order samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer sample orders for most sportswear items. Samples are priced at retail plus shipping, and the cost is often credited back on a bulk order. Contact your sales rep to arrange samples.

faqs.q: What sizes are available for custom sportswear?
faqs.a: Most sportswear items range from XS to 3XL or 4XL. Some styles offer extended sizes up to 5XL. We recommend ordering a sizing kit to ensure proper fit across your team. Size charts are available on each product page.
